name: G1 disaster-recon walk — Khumbu staging area
note: Where an ABot-Recon reconstruction is placed on the globe. A reconstruction is metric but ungeoreferenced (its origin is the first camera), so this anchor is editorial: lat/lon of the clip's first frame, headingDeg the compass bearing that first camera looked along, elevM a ground-relative offset (the slam-local datum snaps it onto terrain). Replays stay SIMULATED - VIRTUAL TRANSPOSITION.
